examples.trans: Seeing her down, her sister went over for a heart-to-heart chat.

重视.gloss: value highly, attach great weight to

meanings.en: value highly, attach great weight to

examples.text: 从这一点就能看出台里面的重视程度了。
examples.trans: From that alone you see how highly the network values it.

examples.text: 总编室非常重视新人的每一个原创想法。
examples.trans: The office values every original idea from newcomers.

针对.gloss: aimed at, tailored to, in view of

meanings.en: aimed at, tailored to, in view of
meanings.note: Directing measures or remarks at a specific case.

examples.text: 针对目前的情况，我们制定了新计划。
examples.trans: In view of the current situation, we drew up a new plan.

examples.text: 这些建议都是专门针对你的问题提出的。
examples.trans: These suggestions were tailored specifically to your issue.

examples.text: 粉丝居然筹到了这么多钱！
examples.trans: Fans actually raised this much money!

examples.text: 等到违约金的钱一到位，合约就结束了。
examples.trans: Once the penalty money clears, the contract ends.

meanings.note: Often used with 有/没 in spoken evaluations.

examples.text: 工作半年以来，她的业务能力很有长进。
examples.trans: Over half a year on the job, her skills have shown real progress.

examples.text: 老犯同样的错误，真是太没长进了。
examples.trans: Making the same mistake again shows zero progress.

闲.gloss: idle, free, having nothing to do

meanings.en: idle, free, having nothing to do
meanings.note: Having spare time on one's hands.

examples.text: 你今天怎么这么闲，不用去盯彩排吗？
examples.trans: How come you have so much free time today—no rehearsal to watch?

examples.text: 忙习惯了的人一旦闲下来反而不适应。
examples.trans: People used to staying busy feel odd once they are idle.

examples.text: 推行新方案往往会遇到很大的阻力。
examples.trans: Pushing through a new plan often meets strong resistance.

examples.text: 只要大家齐心协力，再大的阻力也能克服。
examples.trans: As long as everyone pulls together, any resistance can be overcome.

examples.text: 除了他以外，办公室里其他人都下班了。
examples.trans: Apart from him, everyone else in the office has gone home.

examples.text: 这件事除了好朋友，我谁也没告诉。
examples.trans: Besides my close friend, I told nobody about this.

examples.text: 他们要面对最现实的每一天。
examples.trans: They have to face the most realistic everyday challenges.

examples.text: 用平静的表情面对困难。
examples.trans: Face difficulties with a calm expression.

meanings.note: Classifier xiàng for projects, tasks, or policies.

examples.text: 负责这项工作的同事前两天离职了。
examples.trans: The colleague handling this task left two days ago.

examples.text: 公司今年启动了三项新计划。
examples.trans: The company launched three new initiatives this year.
